scope: Guarded engineering-inference request and Responses parser, real existing owner journal/restricted child fixture rehearsal, immutable evidence, honest UI and browser readiness documentation; no paid transport or authority.
riskAnalysis: Critical task execution, evidence and reviewer boundaries require STRICT; fixture availability cannot imply paid dispatch, semantic acceptance or publication authority.

threatModel.assets: Curated repository source, task and review bindings, worker filesystem, immutable evidence and budget.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner dashboard to existing journal; authority to bounded trusted child; proposed text is untrusted inert data, never code execution.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged owner/reviewer, self-review, resealed source/proposal, stale scope/revision/source, prompt injection, paid permission escalation, repeated tasks and child interruption.
threatModel.mitigations: Existing owner/tenant CAS, exact dependencies and revision/fence/lease guards, immutable source pin, request/response schema, same parser fixtures, empty child environment, confirmed exit, unconditional paid transport denial.

rollback: Cancel new non-billable plan then revert new fixture/templates and UI; preserve historical records and immutable snapshot files required to read them. No Production or original product source changes.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Unknown keys, paths, oversized/overlapping/reversed edits and altered manifests fail fixed validators.
negativePaths.concurrency: Process-owned temporary namespaces prevent false cleanup claims from concurrent tests; existing final CAS remains.
negativePaths.cancellation: Actual child cancellation/timeout waits for cleanup before rejection; no receipt after authority loss.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Child exit/start failures deny artifact; parent-crash orphan and OS resource isolation remain limitations, no untrusted execution enabled.
negativePaths.api-outage: No new provider call in preparation; existing public CI outage produces unavailable evidence, no retries.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Trusted before/after callback must return exact true; existing owner/workspace/task authority and stale claim checks remain.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No paid transport/ledger write exists in fixture path; forged complete proof still denies. Existing model/cost/token limits are preparation contracts, not live-provider caps.
negativePaths.partial-execution: No partial artifact is accepted; source identity and cleanup verified before returned result.

defects.rootCause: Initial first-stage evidence accepted resealed substituted excerpts, and manifest capture and exported file read could disagree.
defects.detectionGap: Self-hash validation proved internal consistency but not authenticity against exact approved immutable source.
defects.regression: Independent full-chain resealing and exported-read substitution tests now reject; captureApproved uses one closure snapshot and immutable v1 pin.
defects.historicalPrevention: Persisted immutable evidence compared to fixed versioned asset; new execution requires exact current bytes; never reread changed live source for old receipts.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend actual existing owner journal and restricted organization child, no new orchestration, spending, authorization or credential system.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing pinned Node, Playwright1.55.0 recipe, curated source lock, exact runtime/release/deployment and Redis CAS; no new package installation.
proactiveReview.threats: Proposal injection, stale authority, substituted evidence, forged review, accidental runtime execution or implicit infrastructure spending.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Missing exact source/runtime denies preparation. Unconfirmed browser digest/quote blocks build; no paid fallback or retry.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Altered proposal/binding/patch, authority denial, ignored preauth, child timeout/cancellation and malicious inert throw text remain covered.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Actual source grouping tests, artifact provenance rejection and true before/after release assertions; no self-approval or fabricated model semantics.
proactiveReview.recovery: Await child cleanup on failure, preserve old evidence; no authority restoration. Parent-hardkill orphan remains explicit future isolation limitation.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused actual owner API/worker/API isolation23, request/Responses/worker30 and UI21 pass; independent auditor pending; frozen STRICT/realRedis19/CI/CodeQL/authenticated hosted rehearsal still required.
